01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

Make it work
harder for you.

Mathura organisations can serve local customers, visitors and distributed teams with different information needs. A well-scoped app can simplify reservations, service requests, schedules, customer communication or staff coordination while keeping the human support route obvious.

We plan mobile usability, content management, permissions and integrations together. Where users do not need an app-store download, a progressive web app can offer a fast home-screen experience with easier distribution and maintenance.

04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01Can you build an app for visitors as well as local customers?+

Yes. We can separate journeys, content and actions for each audience where their needs genuinely differ.

02Would a progressive web app be enough?+

Often it can be. A progressive web app is easier to open and update, while a native or cross-platform app may be better when deeper device features or app-store distribution are important.

03Can staff update information without a developer?+

Yes. We can include an administration area for approved staff to manage content, availability or workflow data based on their roles.
